findings.location: Paragraph containing Ephesians & Matthew citations (near: "L’apostolo Paolo dice...")
findings.source_quote: “. . .a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish” (Eph. 5:27). And Jesus Himself said “. . .That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it” (Matt. 16:18).
findings.suggested_fix: Localize the Bible book names to conventional Italian forms while keeping chapter and verse numbers unchanged. Replace the parenthetical citations (Eph. 5:27) and (Matt. 16:18) with (Efesini 5:27) and (Matteo 16:18) respectively. Preserve punctuation and HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: «. . . una chiesa gloriosa, che non abbia macchia né rughe, né alcuna cosa simile; ma che sia santa e irreprensibile» (Eph. 5:27). E lo stesso Gesù disse «. . . Tu sei Pietro, e su questa pietra edificherò la mia chiesa; e le porte dell'inferno non prevarranno contro di essa» (Matt. 16:18).

findings.location: Paragraph with 1 John citation (near: "La Parola di Dio dice...")
findings.source_quote: “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness” (1 John 1:9).
findings.suggested_fix: Localize the Bible book name to conventional Italian form while keeping chapter and verse numbers unchanged. Replace (1 John 1:9) with (1 Giovanni 1:9). Preserve the translated verse text.
findings.translation_quote: «Se confessiamo i nostri peccati, egli è fedele e giusto da perdonarci i peccati e purificarci da ogni iniquità» (1 John 1:9).

findings.location: Paragraph with Matthew 11:5 citation (near: "The blind receive their sight...")
findings.source_quote: “The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them ” (Matt. 11:5).
findings.suggested_fix: Localize the Bible book name. Replace (Matt. 11:5) with (Matteo 11:5), keeping the translated verse text intact and preserving spacing/punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: «I ciechi riacquistano la vista, e gli zoppi camminano, i lebbrosi sono purificati, e i sordi odono, i morti sono risuscitati, e ai poveri è predicato il vangelo» (Matt. 11:5).

findings.location: List of citations under "Sottomissione" (James, Hebrews, 1 Peter, Ephesians)
findings.source_quote:

  • [to those] that have the [spiritual] rule over you [us] (Heb. 13:17).
  • to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake (1 Pet. 2:13).

Suggested replacements: (Jas. 4:7) → (Giacomo 4:7), (Heb. 13:17) → (Ebrei 13:17), (1 Pet. 2:13) → (1 Pietro 2:13), (Eph. 5:21) → (Efesini 5:21). Keep bracketed editorial clarifications exactly as they appear.

findings.location: Multiple paragraphs where parenthetical Scripture citations remain in English-abbreviated form (e.g., (Eph. 5:27), (Matt. 16:18), (1 John 1:9), (Matt. 11:5), (2 Tim. 3:12), (Jas. 4:7), (Heb. 13:17), (1 Pet. 2:13), (Eph. 5:21), (John 13:35), (1 Cor. 13:7))
findings.source_quote: All occurrences of parenthetical scripture citations using English abbreviations in the source.
findings.suggested_fix: Systematically replace all English/abbreviated Bible book references with their standard Italian equivalents throughout the HTML while preserving exact chapter:verse numbers and all surrounding punctuation. Examples: Eph. → Efesini; Matt. → Matteo; 1 John → 1 Giovanni; 2 Tim. → 2 Timoteo; Jas. → Giacomo; Heb. → Ebrei; 1 Pet. → 1 Pietro; John → Giovanni; 1 Cor. → 1 Corinzi.
